plan.purpose: Finite 2x2: PPO learning rate (3e-5 / 1.5e-5) x train-split rehearsal (none / lambda 5). All arms use placement adapter v2 pinned from the production config; evaluation v1 rules (66 validation openings, case_id retention, paired battles). No adoption, no resident operation, no automatic extension.
plan.seed_note: Seeds repeat the previous A/B (10000555, 10000777, 10000999); this is a follow-up after seeing those results, not an independent final confirmation.
